hooks.command: { echo "=== HANDOFF (auto-injected): ledger + latest session ==="; awk '/^## Session /{n++} n<2' HANDOFF.md; timeout 5 git fetch -q; n=$(git rev-list --count "HEAD..@{u}" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$n" ] && [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then echo "WARNING: super-landscaper-2 is $n commit(s) behind origin. Pull before working."; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
